SettingsForm_lblAdvancedDbToolWarning:
⚠ This is an advanced feature that edits the database directly.
A mistaken operation can corrupt or lose data. It launches as a
separate process — please close IwaraDownloader before using it.
SettingsForm_lblAdvancedNote:
* Rate limit settings reduce server load and prevent 403/429 errors.
* Values that are too small may get your access restricted.
* Values that are too large slow down downloads.
SettingsForm_lblMigrationNote:
Writes iwara UUID tags into previously downloaded video files.
Tagged files can be re-discovered even after DB loss or renaming.
SettingsForm_lblMinFreeSpaceNote: GB — downloads won't start below this (0 = disabled)
SettingsForm_lblPythonNote: * If setup has already been completed, only the path is changed (no library reinstall needed)
SettingsForm_lblYtDlpNote: * "yt-dlp" (from PATH) is fine. If not installed, pip install is attempted automatically
